The handoff

Forty years of Enumclaw backs

Some practices get built. This one got handed down — license to license, doctor to doctor.

An honors grad

The story

New hands, same care

A bad back in Enumclaw has meant one thing for as long as most of the town can remember: go see Dr. Devlin — the kind of doctor whose patients get carried in by their husbands and leave ready to dance.

Then came the handoff most small towns never get. Rather than a new sign across the street, Dr. Beau Rogers stepped into the practice itself and kept it going as Beau Rogers Chiropractic PLLC — with the unhurried chair-side manner the reviews keep mentioning.
